title: caddy model
$comment:
DERIVED from the 16 caddy records in ims-data on 2026-09-16, not hand-authored.
It describes what the catalogue actually contains so that a NEW record cannot quietly
omit a field every existing record has -- the failure that let cpu.memory_types read a
key no record had, silently disabling that rule on every CPU for months.
Regenerate rather than hand-edit when the corpus legitimately changes shape.
WIDENED 2026-09-22 when the corpus grew to 20 records: dimensions/weight made optional (unverifiable for the
four CtrlS trays, and nothing reads weight; dimensions is read with a [] default), and six
provenance keys admitted. Nothing in the rules reads any of the six.

dimensions.$comment: present on 16 of 20 records -- the four CtrlS-sheet trays record no dimensions because no verified source exists; do not invent one

uuid.$comment: The only identity a model has and the sole join key to caddyinventory.

weight.$comment: present on 16 of 20 records -- same four trays, same reason
